audit_scope: Existing saved responses and a deterministic rebuild using the frozen Native planning module. No new API, model, booking, database or Native mutations.

typed_fixture.consequence: This case does not qualify breakfast, refundability, luggage, detailed room/bed preferences or arbitrary hard constraints.

coverage_units.meaning: One two-room hotel offer covers two room component IDs; seven selected offers cover nine required components.

birthday_scope: Actual source request/response ages are6/12 on the first stay/flight, then7/12. Raw dates of birth and passenger IDs are not exported.
fx_scope: CBR reference conversion; banking/payment FX and commissions remain unknown, not executable purchase rates.
source_count_scope: Six durable search tool starts are not a count of supplier HTTP requests; wire count for the successful Native flow was not instrumented.

supplier_comparison.retained_older_actual_hotel_evidence: Dubai/Istanbul prebook samples and actual-group-flow-20261026 also retain only nuitee/2; repeated serialization is not a different supplier.
supplier_comparison.duffel_reason_not_comparable: The three offers price three different flight legs, not competing sellers of the same hotel/date/room product.
supplier_comparison.serp_retention_limit: Three saved market hotel samples have listed_sellers=[]; the other17 results were counted but their full offers were not retained.
missing_facts: At least two distinct response-sourced sellers for one canonical property and query
Equivalent room/bed, occupancy, board, cancellation and eligibility conditions
Comparable full mandatory-fee stay totals in one currency at a recorded time
